flow_summary: The system handles the confused, disorganised patient well by consistently rephrasing vague or muddled answers, breaking questions into smaller parts, and confirming details before moving on. It asks one clear question at a time, pursues missing clinically relevant information, checks for additional entries on repeatable topics, and delivers the required safety response when current risk is disclosed. Minor issues include a few mechanical full-question repetitions and one slightly bundled safety-plus-reask message.

issues.evidence: PHQ-9 turn 15: "Thank you for telling me. Your immediate safety is important. ... Before we move on, could you answer the question above?"
Multiple PHQ-9/GAD-7 turns where the full numbered question + scale is repeated verbatim after "I lost the thread" without extra scaffolding.
